_comment: Compose with: node tools/screenshots/compose.mjs apps/language-drills/store/screenshots.json apps/language-drills/store/screenshots/en-US. Raw captures come from app-verify (apps/language-drills/qa) and are copied into store/raw. Shot 1 is the win, because a wall of a stranger's own tiles is the picture that makes someone want the app. Shots 3 and 4 are the wedge said plainly: a thousand words in the order you meet them, bought once. The background is the app's own cobalt glaze on night plaster, not a generic navy.

shots.title: Build a wall you keep
shots.subtitle: Every word you learn is a tile in it.

shots.title: It remembers what you forget
shots.subtitle: Each word comes back as it starts to slip.

shots.title: 1,000 words, in order of use
shots.subtitle: The ones you actually meet, first.

shots.title: One number that only goes up
shots.subtitle: No streak. No calendar of missed days.

shots.title: It stops when you are done
shots.subtitle: A missed day costs you nothing.

shots.title: Spanish that is still there in March
shots.subtitle: Ten minutes before bed. On a plane too.
